evals.prompt: Our core insurance policy-administration system runs on an IBM z/OS mainframe (COBOL 6, CICS BMS screens, Db2 z/OS, VSAM KSDS files, and nightly JCL batch jobs), and we are targeting AWS `ap-south-1`. We have 100% of the source code and copybooks, and our CTO wants to completely exit COBOL skills and evolve the product rapidly in Java. First run a read-only check in `ap-south-1` via `aws-mcp` (`m2:ListApplications`, `ecs:ListClusters`, `stepfunctions:ListStateMachines`). Second, state the mandatory 2026 guardrail regarding AWS Mainframe Modernization (M2) Managed Runtime, and design the target **AWS Blu Age** automated refactoring architecture via AWS Transform.
evals.expected_output: Enforces the 2026 guardrail that the standalone AWS Mainframe Modernization (M2) Managed Runtime Environment is closed to new customers and routes through AWS Transform for mainframe (`aws-transform-mcp`) using **AWS Blu Age**, detailing how COBOL/CICS/BMS transform to Java 17/21 + Spring Boot + Angular on Amazon ECS/EKS, how Db2/VSAM migrate to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (EBCDIC to UTF-8/ASCII, `COMP-3` to `NUMERIC`/`BigDecimal`), and how JCL batch orchestrates via Groovy/Spring Batch + AWS Step Functions + EventBridge Scheduler.
expectations: Performs read-only discovery in `ap-south-1` via `aws-mcp` (`m2:ListApplications`, `ecs:ListClusters`, `stepfunctions:ListStateMachines`) without mutating resources.

Explicitly states the mandatory 2026 guardrail: the standalone AWS Mainframe Modernization (M2) Managed Runtime Environment is closed to new customers, and directs mainframe modernization to AWS Transform (`aws-transform-mcp`).

Details the AWS Blu Age refactoring architecture: COBOL/CICS/BMS -> Java 17/21 Spring Boot + Angular on ECS/EKS, VSAM/Db2 -> Aurora PostgreSQL (ASCII/UTF-8), and JCL -> Groovy/Spring Batch orchestrated by AWS Step Functions.
